options.transfer.description: Save selected settings in a global profile and merge them into other saves with a review step. History, active alarms, and world-bound object IDs are never transferred.

options.transfer.category.window_layout_: Window positions, sizes, and open detached panels. Off by default because resolutions and monitor arrangements can differ; an import applies immediately and stays viewport-clamped.
